editorialMarkers: Chapter and verse numbers follow the Ethiopian tradition and may differ from Hebrew, Greek or English editions; a book is present only where Beta maṣāḥǝft has an edition of it. Word-level transliterations exist upstream and are not taken here. Nothing in this package is equated with a book of another canon except where the text itself is the same book.
